messages.en: My car's broken down by the side of the road. I've already called a garage.
Where are you? Want me to come and pick you up?
I'll just have two pieces of roti canai. Have you ordered yet?
Not yet. I was waiting for you. Want some dhal with that?

senses.en_definition: A bay between two rows of posts or within four posts in a traditional house.
An open or unoccupied space within a building; a room or an area used for a particular purpose.
A hollow space within an object or the body; a cavity.
A three-dimensional space bounded by surfaces.
In philosophy, the boundless expanse in which all things exist.
An interval between two points in time; an available period of time.
An internal compartment or chamber of a fruit.
An interior space in a ship or boat, especially a hold used for cargo.
A section or column in a newspaper or other publication; a column for writing figures.
A field, sphere, or range of activity, knowledge, or discussion.
An opportunity or scope to act, develop, or improve.

messages.en: I'm outside your house now. Where should I wait?
Just come in and take a seat in the living room. I'm making us some drinks.

senses.en_definition: A building used as a place to live; a house or home.
A building or premises, especially in compound names indicating a particular purpose.
A group of pupils forming a team for school sports, often identified by a colour; a house.
The position occupied by a digit in a number.

messages.en: I'm home now. Want to pop over for a quick drink?
I'd love to! I'm at the shop right in front of your house. Shall I pick up some bread too?
That sounds good. I'll make some tea.
